summary: Keep construction and recognizable material relationships while deliberately exaggerating selected shapes or color relationships.
objective: The intended exaggeration is identifiable, while feet, hinges and supported parts retain coherent connections.
intent_signals: Retain construction cues while exaggerating selected forms
example_prompts: Create a stylized-realistic village with expressive roofs but clearly supported buildings.

principles: Keep construction and recognizable material relationships while deliberately exaggerating selected shapes or color relationships.
implementation: Retain functional joints and major proportions as anchors; exaggerate one expressive silhouette feature at a time.
Use grounded surface separation with a selectively heightened palette and controlled focal light.
Choose a cinematic or exploratory camera that still supports object inspection; let expressive secondary motion coexist with clear model boundaries.

Scale exactly one feature per asset by 1.15-1.25x (hand, roof pitch, wheel diameter) and leave every other proportion true; record the multiplier in design-system.md so collision and interaction meshes can compensate.

Halve normal-map strength with normalScale.set(0.5, 0.5) and raise minimum roughness to 0.35 while keeping metalness binary; the surface then reads as painted without losing the material separation that makes it believable.
observable_checks: The intended exaggeration is identifiable, while feet, hinges and supported parts retain coherent connections.

defaults.rationale: This style fails in two directions, so the numbers fence both: albedo is held between 20% and 45% saturation because below that it drifts into photoreal and above it into cartoon, and exactly one silhouette feature is exaggerated by 15-25% while joints, contacts and shadows stay physically plausible. A 4:1 key with a warm 34-degree sun and a cool hemisphere fill gives the warm/cool separation that carries stylised forms, and ACESFilmic at 1.0 keeps the pushed accent from clipping.

palette.role: muted complementary for skin and cloth

values.value_structure: 40/40/20 dark/mid/light; the hero silhouette holds the single largest uninterrupted value mass
values.saturation_rule: base albedo 20-45% HSL; only the accent and the light colour exceed 60%, and nothing drops below 12% or the look slides into photoreal

lights.ratio: key:fill ~ 4:1 on a neutral card; the rim stays near one third of the key so it draws the contour without flattening the form

values.intensity_unit: three-intensity (lux-scaled for Directional/Hemisphere, candela for Point/Spot; tuned with the stated tone_mapping.exposure)

materials.notes: keep true material separation (metal 1.0, everything else 0) but flatten normalScale to 0.5 and enlarge every bevel to 3-6 mm so forms still read at 20% zoom

post.dof: off during orbit; hero at f/2.8 for held shots

values.signature_technique: exaggerate one silhouette feature by 15-25% while every joint, seam and contact shadow stays physically plausible, so the eye accepts the lie
never: photoreal microdetail on an exaggerated form
black shadows with no fill colour

known_limits: Values are authored starting points tuned for ACESFilmic tone mapping at exposure 1.0; re-tune every intensity, fog density and bloom threshold if you change the tone mapping or exposure.
No renderer run for this record; values are authored starting points.
creative_affordances: Combine with painterly atmosphere or hand-painted accents; explicitly factual dimensions remain unaltered unless the view declares a visual exaggeration.
